entries.zh: 收拢、收集；收藏（兵器），引申收敛、止息
entries.en: to gather, put together; to store away (weapons); to restrain

entries.zh: 叠、堆叠（一件摞在另一件上）；重叠、叠起
entries.en: to put one thing on top of another; to pile, stack, double up

entries.zh: 佩带、随身挂带（把东西挂在身上携带）；佩挂饰物
entries.en: to wear, carry hanging on one's person; to bring along

entries.zh: 央人作中、立人为中保（荐某人做居间人／中人）
entries.en: to appoint (someone) as intercessor, mediator or guarantor (middleman)
entries.notes: 汉字栏「記」与西语“立为中人”不合；M 两读疑为「央中」类说法但逐字未核实，释义据西语栏定。

entries.zh: 熨、热敷（如热布敷熨腹部那样敷熨身体他处）；熨烫（次要）
entries.en: to foment, apply hot cloths to the stomach or elsewhere; to iron
entries.notes: M 栏「V. tio.」为互见缩写（véase，参见他条），展开属推断；释义据汉字「熨」与西语热敷描述。

entries.zh: 揉、搓揉（揉擦、按摩肌肤）；揉和
entries.en: to knead, rub, massage (the skin); to work dough
entries.notes: 西语释义文字残损难辨（“essa casa en la planta p̃…”），M 例词音写未逐字核实，据汉字「揉」与 M 音揉搓义相合定。

entries.zh: 潜、潜入水中（潜藏、潜泳）；沉入水下
entries.en: to dive, submerge oneself; to hide, lie concealed; to sink
entries.notes: 西语「a dos fuerras, o p̃es.」难解且缩写未展开，据汉字「潛」与 M 两读定潜藏义。

entries.zh: 斟酒、注酒（双手把酒杯摆上桌）；奉酒劝饮
entries.en: to pour wine, fill the cups and set them on the table with both hands; to serve wine

entries.zh: 接上、接合（把东西连接在一起）
entries.en: to join, put together, attach (head character uncertain: 接/戢)
entries.notes: 西语「en hiesto」未定（或为 hierro／enhiesto 之讹），汉字栏标「戢／接」存疑，M 音更合「接」，取接合义。

entries.zh: 箕踞（两腿叉开、一腿搭在股上的坐姿，傲慢之态）
entries.en: to sit sprawled with the legs out, one leg over the thigh; an insolent sitting posture

entries.zh: 垫在底下（在物件下面垫放东西，使其安放稳妥）
entries.en: to put something underneath as a base, to seat a thing firmly
entries.notes: 汉字栏「亏／方」存疑且与 M 两读音不合，对应汉字未定，释义据西语“垫于物下使其安稳”。

entries.zh: 挂、悬挂（把东西挂上去安放好）
entries.en: to hang up, suspend; to put in place
entries.notes: 西语读作“asentándolo（安放）”与「挂」义稍隔，疑为 colgando 之误辨，据汉字「掛」与 M 音定悬挂义。

entries.zh: 箍戴（把冠冕或首饰箍戴在头上）；箍、束箍
entries.en: to put a crown or jewels on the head; to hoop, encircle
entries.notes: M「cou.」入声读法与「箍」不合，音据存疑，释义据汉字「箍」与西语“冠冕首饰戴于头上”。

entries.zh: 命名、取名（给人名字／表字）；表明、表出（次要）
entries.en: to give a name, to name someone; to express, make known

entries.zh: 日暮、日落（太阳落山之时）；傍晚
entries.en: sunset, at the going down of the sun; dusk

entries.zh: 晡、下晡（午后偏晚、日将落下之时分）
entries.en: late afternoon toward sundown; the time when the sun sets

entries.zh: 垒、堆垒（石上叠石，一层层堆起来）
entries.en: to pile stone upon stone, heap up; to build up a pile
entries.notes: 汉字栏作「疊」但 M 音更合「壘」（「疊」另有第 2 条读音），疑为「壘」字，释义取叠石堆垒义。

entries.zh: 压上、压住（把东西压在上面，免得被风吹走）
entries.en: to put a weight on top (of something) so the wind will not carry it off; to press down
entries.notes: 西语谓压物其上免被风移（“…el aire”），汉字栏「遏／過」存疑，M 音对应字未定。

entries.zh: 放、搁、放置（放到某处或随处安放）
entries.en: to put, place, set down (in a spot or anywhere)

entries.zh: 落钱（出资入伙，把钱投进合伙生意）
entries.en: to put money into a company, invest in a partnership

entries.zh: 佮本（合本，凑本钱合伙经营）
entries.en: to pool capital, join one's money in a partnership

entries.zh: 落舵、掌舵（把住船舵，操舟行船）
entries.en: to take the helm, hold the tiller and steer

entries.zh: 抛脚（把脚抛搭在腿股上，跷腿而坐）
entries.en: to throw one leg over the thigh, sit with the legs crossed
entries.notes: 汉字「拋脚后股」与 M 逐字对应未核实（末音对「股」存疑），释义据西语与第 10 条同款。
